english.note: Use 拒絕 as the all-purpose verb for refusing or declining something; add a softening phrase to make the refusal polite.
This is the all-purpose choice for refusing an offer, acceptance, or romantic advance.
This is the all-purpose choice for rejecting a request or demand.
This is the straightforward general verb for refusing a request or refusing to do something, especially in more formal wording.
Choose this when the emphasis is on explicitly refusing or rejecting a request, application, or proposal rather than merely withholding permission.

examples.english: I’m sorry, but I have to decline your invitation.
examples.traditional: 我諗過喇，唔好意思，我要拒絕你嘅邀請。
